notes.title: Patch 2 Fixes and Enhancements
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Skull buy feature backup to fix some rare issues with skills that where not acquired in the dojo. If this is the case talk to the Dojo Master again about the skill you are missing.

[*]Added a backup solution if you leave Broken Cave via the entrance after freeing Wuuri. Cygnus will now appear anyway.

[*]Spider can not be triggered from behind the wall anymore.

[*] Altered the camera behavior so it moves less aggressively and considers the facing direction of Leif.

[*] Fixed missing wall and or ceiling colliders in Crimson Quarry.

[*] Added slight ramp to Crimson Quarry so the rolling boulder can not be reach a blocked state on the right side.

[*] Added an auto save point after the Ice Golem.

[*] Added ceiling boundary for Ghost to prevent camera from snapping out of bounds.

[*] Reduced height of the damage collider in the slopes during the rotating wheel in Tigros Kingdom to prevent them from peeking through the wheel's wall.

[*] Made the passage of the first rotating wheel in in Tigros Kindom bigger for easier exit.

[*] Fixed a handful of edge hang collider issues where Leif snapped to a stage position when hanging on a ledge.

[*] Fixed some typos

[*]Added FMOD Logo to startup screen

[*]Added backup solution for Wuuri not appearing in front of the great tree if you leave the game without saving after the conversation with him in the potion shop.

[*]Fixed Hammerupgrade achievements triggers. If you have solved all challenge level and did not get the achievement for it just revisit the tower and you will get it. 

[*]Fixed Journal Echos of Redemption subtask not crossed out after finishing the quest.
[/list]

notes.title: Major Beta Updates: 1.9.6. - 17 (23.08.24)
notes.content:
🚀 Beta Update 1.9.6. - 17 is Now Live! 🚀

I'm excited to bring you our latest update, packed with new features, enhancements, and fixes to improve your gaming experience!

🎨 Enjoy new alternative title screen visuals and discover more destructible items in snowy areas. 🗺️ The map system has been upgraded with Warp Stone and save point indicators, and I’ve squashed numerous bugs to make your journey smoother. 🎶 Experience enriched soundscapes with added sound effects and music across various scenes.

Dive into the game and explore all the new content I’ve prepared for you!

Thank you for your continued support and feedback!

[h2]New Stuff[/h2]
[list]
[*] 🎨 Added alternative title screen visuals
[*] ❄️ Added more destructible items in snowy areas
[*] 🕊️ Added quest resolution for the empathy quest
[*] ⚔️ Added better weapons to golden treasure chests
[*] 💰 Added Ghost Orbs selling feature, including different exchange rates
[/list]

[h2]Map Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] 🗺️ Added Warp Stone and save point indicators to maps
[*] 🔍 Fixed the map zoom bug
[*] 🏝️ Fixed the "unknown island map" bug and many other minor map-related bugs
[*] 📄 Changed map open functionality to remember the last used page
[*] 🛑 Fixed the map trigger issue that instantly closed the map menu again
[/list]

[h2]User Interface Enhancements[/h2]
[list]
[*] ⚠️ Added a low weapon durability warning to the UI
[*] 🎮 Fixed the wrong input hint for the wall jump upgrade shrine (keyboard)
[*] 📋 Added an extra menu to the title screen
[*] 📜 Optimized the quest journal
[/list]

[h2]Sound and Music Additions[/h2]
[list]
[*] 🎶 Added sound effects or music to all animated cutscenes
[*] 📡 Added sound effects for Warp Stone and portal usage
[*] 🎵 Added music to the Pyramid Pub
[*] 🌲 Added ambience and sound effects to the return to White Forest section
[*] 🔊 Added a lot of missing sound effects
[*] 🔔 Fixed missing weapon pick-up sound effects
[*] 🎸 Added ambience and music to extras credits and extras intro song
[*] 🗣️ Added a lot of NPC sound effects
[*] 🧪 Added SFX for consuming potions
[*] 🥋 Added SFX for Dojo upgrades
[*] 🚪 Added SFX to Wuuri portal
[*] 
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] 👻 Fixed ghost conversation in Odin’s blue level
[*] 🐢 Fixed slow-opening treasure chest
[*] 🦒 Fixed Leif's neck problem
[*] 🖼️ Fixed quest pickup canvas bugs
[*] ⏪ Fixed Sandfall backwards travel bug
[*] 🚁 Fixed propeller animation on airship
[*] 🏚️ Fixed hideout door bugs
[*] 🪓 Fixed seal destruction cutscene that was not playing
[*] 🎼 Fixed music not playing at mountaintop
[*] 🛑 Fixed the no-combo bug after weapon throw
[*] 🔨 Fixed wrong hammer display at hammer upgrade statues
[*] Performance Enhancements
[*] ⚡ Improved performance in the Ariibora level
[*] 🚀 Improved performance for ToC 7 Level
[/list]
[h2]Miscellaneous[/h2]
[list]
[*] 🛠️ Added backup floor colliders for doors
[*] 🔄 Increased client bundle version to 17
[*] 🗑️ Removed debug information
[*] 🆕 Changed implementation of the "new game plus" feature
[*] 🚪Updated Credits
[/list]

notes.title: Leif's Adventure - Closed Beta Update 0.5 - 15
notes.content:
* Major localization update for the German texts. They are now 90% complete.

* Changed the save slot changing rhythm to 30 minutes. You can roll back up to 2.5 hours. 

* Added "Next Goal" feature. This gives players a clear idea of what to do next. (Journal)

* Completely reworked the Sandfalls Boss fight background.

* Improved the passdown movement for Leif by adding a threshold for the analog stick.

* Added better support for different aspect ratios (PC)

* Fixed camera collider issues in RedRock.

* Fixed the white parrots - they can fly now!

* Added some more decoration details to the White Forest caves.

* Fixed sorting layer problems in roller coaster section (RR)

* Fixed squirrel bug after waking up.

* Changed the Main Menu UI to reflect whether you have played the game before or not. Start/Continue

* Fixed distortion effects bug.

* Fixed Spectra bug in the Tower of Challenge

* Reworked the appearance of the mythical creatures.

* Added a keydropping backup system to eliminate the case where the player did not get the last prison key. (Sand Falls)

* Simplified the collider structure for Sand Falls to improve performance (switch).

* Fixed the condition issue with the brother extraction.

* A lot of smaller bug fixes and some more polish for Sand Falls and Red Rock as well as Ariibora.
